messages:
samir: Hi team, quick one  I charged a business dinner + a mandatory airport lounge day-pass on the corp card. Bank posted single charge 'GLOBAL TRAVEL' for $132. Receipt from restaurant shows $94 food, receipt from lounge shows $30 entry, plus $8 service fee on the card. How do I submit to get the lounge reimbursed vs meals?
rachel: @samir please upload both receipts to Expensify and add a short note splitting the amounts. For tax purposes we code meals vs facilities differently. Also note if any personal portion (did you bring a guest?).
samir: Uploading now: `samir_17190077_restaurant.pdf` and `samir_17190077_lounge.pdf`. No guest, all business. I left a note: "Dinner team dinner w/ product, lounge day-pass for delayed flight". The card line shows a $8 "service fee" that isn't on either merchant receipt.
ante: @samir thanks. Finance policy: service fees tied to the merchant get coded to vendor fees; small miscellaneous charges under $10 can be expensed to "travel:fees". For the split, we'll code $94 -> meals, $30 -> travel:facilities, $8 -> travel:fees.
finance-bot: Reminder: corporate card policy requires an itemized receipt for meals >$75. If receipts uploaded and manager confirms business purpose, transactions <= $150 are usually processed within 5 business days.
rachel: Quick heads-up: since meal >$75, please include attendee names in the expense note. I approved the lounge portion pending attendee list to clear meal approval checklist.
samir: Added attendee names and manager tag. Also changed receipt filenames to include last4: `receipt_4321_restaurant.pdf`, `receipt_4321_lounge.pdf`. Anything else?
ante: All good. I'll route these to AP for settlement and tag GL codes: meals: 6100, facilities: 6250, fees: 6805. Closing the thread.
samir: Thanks!"
